name: Coffee Pub Librarian
tagline: Campaign codex and quest tracker, readable at the table.
description: A searchable codex of characters, locations, factions and artifacts with JSON import and cross-linking, plus a quest tracker with objectives, canvas pins and GM-controlled visibility.
pitch: Keep your campaign world organized with a searchable codex and map-pinned quests, and decide exactly what your players get to see.

features.title: Searchable codex
features.text: Characters, locations, factions and artifacts grouped by category and filtered by tag.

features.title: JSON import
features.text: Bring in notes written in other tools by importing entries from JSON.

features.title: Linked entries
features.text: Entries link to each other by name; a reference to an unwritten entry becomes a link once it exists.

features.title: GM reveal control
features.text: Entries start hidden; the GM chooses what players see and GM-only content stays private.

features.title: Quest tracking
features.text: Track quests by status, with objectives, hints and treasure attached to individual steps.

features.title: Quest map pins
features.text: Quests and objectives appear as canvas pins; double-click a pin to open the quest.

steps: Open the Codex browser from the Librarian button in the menubar.
Click the ... menu in the window title bar, choose Codex options, and select a journal (create an empty one named Codex if needed).
Repeat for Quests: open Quests, use ... to select a quest journal.
